snippet.description:
"Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?"
The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body, the coming-of-age adventure game by CAVYHOUSE, is available on Nintendo Switch/Playstation4･5 from March 19, 2026!
